Introduction

LC9 was a 5 member boy group formed by Nega Network. They made their debut in May of 2013 with the mini album "SKIRMISH" and its title track "Mama Beat" which featured Brown Eyed Girls's Gain.

The groups lineup originally consisted of members Rasa, E.Den, J-Hyo, King, Jun, and AO. In 2014 it was announced that E.Den would be leaving the group to continue his studies. Later that same year, leader Rasa enlisted in the military and the group made their first and final comeback with the single "East of Eden".

In 2016 it was announced by their company that the group had officially disbanded in 2015 after the member's contracts ended.
